issues.legal_issue: A court may reduce compensation derived from comparable sales when material differences between the sale land and acquired land make the sale price an unreliable direct measure of the acquired land’s value.
material_facts: The claimants appealed the High Court’s reduction of compensation for acquired land.
The comparable sale was genuine and occurred close to the notification date.

The sale land was dry, situated on a main road, and comprised a small plot; the acquired land was wet, lay some distance from the main road without direct access, required reclamation, and was substantially larger.
The High Court reduced the compensation below the value reflected in the comparable sale.
issues.conclusion: The High Court was justified in reducing the compensation because the differences in location, access, nature, and plot size disadvantaged the acquired land; the Supreme Court found no infirmity in its judgment.
issues.legal_principle: Comparable Sales Method is generally preferred because it provides evidence of the price a willing purchaser would pay in an open-market sale at the time of the Section 4 notification under the Land Acquisition Act. It is not conclusive: relevant factors include whether the sale was genuine and proximate, whether the lands are in the same vicinity and similar, and whether their plot sizes are comparable. Where differences in locality, shape, site, or nature disadvantage the acquired land, compensation may be proportionately reduced. The judgment relies on Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act and does not rely on an earlier case; Printers House Pvt. Ltd. v. Mst. Saiyadan was cited by the appellants.

rule.if: land_compensation_appeal and comparable_sale_genuine and comparable_sale_proximate and (comparable_land_dissimilar or comparable_plot_smaller) and acquired_land_disadvantaged

predicates.land_compensation_appeal: A claimant challenged a court’s determination of compensation for acquired land.
predicates.comparable_sale_genuine: The court found that the sale used for comparison was a genuine transaction.
predicates.comparable_sale_proximate: The comparable sale occurred close in time to the relevant acquisition notification.
predicates.comparable_land_dissimilar: The land in the comparable sale differed materially from the acquired land in features such as location, access, or nature.
predicates.comparable_plot_smaller: The plot in the comparable sale was smaller than the acquired land.
predicates.acquired_land_disadvantaged: The acquired land had disadvantages, such as poor access or a need for reclamation, compared with the sale land.

issues.definition: When a claimant challenges compensation based on a genuine, timely comparable sale, material differences in the lands and disadvantages affecting the acquired land can support reducing the sale-based value.

issues.legal_issue: A valuation-method challenge fails when the court in fact valued acquired land by comparable sales and referred to capitalization only by way of illustration.
material_facts: The claimants argued that, having opted for the Comparable Sales Method, the High Court could not determine compensation using the capitalization method.
The High Court had granted compensation using the Comparable Sales Method.
The reference to the Capitalisation Method was only illustrative.
issues.conclusion: The claimants’ submission had no merit because the High Court used the Comparable Sales Method and mentioned capitalization only by way of illustration.
issues.legal_principle: The court rejected the challenge on the factual basis that the valuation was made by the Comparable Sales Method, not by capitalization. The judgment does not rely on a separate statutory provision or earlier case for this conclusion.

rule.if: land_compensation_appeal and claimant_relied_on_comparable_method and comparable_sales_method_used and capitalization_method_mentioned_only_illustratively

predicates.land_compensation_appeal: A claimant challenged a court’s determination of compensation for acquired land.
predicates.claimant_relied_on_comparable_method: The claimant argued that the court should determine compensation using the Comparable Sales Method.
predicates.comparable_sales_method_used: The court determined compensation using comparable sales.
predicates.capitalization_method_mentioned_only_ill: The court referred to capitalization only as an illustration rather than as the method used to determine compensation.

issues.definition: When a claimant’s challenge concerns the use of a different valuation method, the challenge fails if comparable sales were actually used and capitalization was mentioned only illustratively.
